12.1 Dealing with the Council
12.2 Coronation ceremony
Player
What's all this about?
Martin Holt
Ah, hello and welcome. I'm Martin Holt, leader of Kourend's Royal Society. This is our little protest against the Kourend Council.
Player
Pleased to meet you, I'm [player name]. So, what's wrong with the Council?
Martin Holt
Now there's a question! I have a better one. What's right with the Council?
Martin Holt
I bet you didn't know that the Council was originally only temporary. After the last King died, they were only supposed to rule until his daughter came of age.
Martin Holt
However, according to the Council, the King's daughter went mad. Such a wonderful convenience for them of course. With her out of the picture, the Council became permanent.
Player
Interesting. What else don't you like about the Council?
Martin Holt
Democracy! That's meant to be the big thing for the Council. Funny thing is, although they're meant to be elected by the people, the same four people have won every single election. Little odd, no?
Player
That is a bit suspicious, I suppose.
Martin Holt
Oh my friend, suspicious is the dish of the day whenever the Council is around. And what I've just told you barely scratches the surface. Things have been getting even worse recently.
Start the quest A Kingdom Divided?
Yes.
Player
How so?
Martin Holt
Do you know of Councillor Sophia Hughes? Lovely lady. Spends her free time with the Disciples of Yama, a wonderful cult of Zamorakian demon summoners.
Player
Councillor Hughes? I was the one who helped imprison her in the first place.
Martin Holt
Ah, so you're the adventurer who's been cooking up a storm around here. Well you'll be pleased to know your hard work was all for nothing. Councillor Hughes has escaped. Lucky her.
Player
Escaped? How?
Martin Holt
Believe it or not, no one actually knows. The Council is trying to keep it all on the down low of course. Almost like they have something to hide.
Player
That's quite the accusation. Do you have proof?
Martin Holt
Oh, we will soon! Just you give it time. They'll slip up sooner or later.
Player
Hmm... Rather than just waiting for that to happen, maybe I could investigate her escape.
Martin Holt
What an interesting idea. I suppose you would be well placed to have a little nosey, considering your history with the Councillor. Though you'd need to get permission, of course.
Player
How would I do that?
Martin Holt
I hear the Kourend Royal Guard are leading the investigation. Commander Lydia Fullore is their leader. You'll find her in the castle.
Player
I'll go speak to her.
Martin Holt
Good luck friend. Your eyes are open now. Don't trust the Council.
No.
Player
Well, I think I'll stay out of this one. Good luck with your protest.
Martin Holt
As you wish, but you shouldn't be afraid to open your eyes. If you change your mind, we'll be here.
(End of dialogue)
Player
How so?
Martin Holt
Do you know of Councillor Sophia Hughes? Lovely lady. Spends her free time with the Disciples of Yama, a wonderful cult of Zamorakian demon summoners.

As you wish, but you shouldn't be afraid to open your eyes. If you change your mind, we'll be here.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Hey there. Remind me, where can I find Commander Fullore?
Martin Holt
She'll be somewhere in the castle.
Player
Thank you.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Hello. Who are you?
Commander Fullore
I'm Commander Lydia Fullore, leader of the Kourend Royal Guard.
Player
Then you're just the person I'm looking for. I'm [player name]. I hear you're the one to talk to about the recent escape of Councillor Hughes.
Commander Fullore
Ah, let me guess, you've been talking to Martin Holt?
Player
You know him?
Commander Fullore
Oh, I know him alright. Martin and I have quite the history.
Player
Really? He didn't mention it.
Commander Fullore
He wouldn't. He has a very selective memory. I imagine he also didn't mention that he used to work for the Council that he hates so much.
Player
No... that's not something that ever came up.
Commander Fullore
Well I imagine his Royal Society friends wouldn't make so much of him if they knew where his loyalties used to lie.
Player
So I'm guessing you don't agree with his views on the Council.
Commander Fullore
Well I wouldn't be very good at my job if I did. Martin is always quick to point out the failings of the Council, but he conveniently forgets about all the good they've done.
Player
Like?
Commander Fullore
You know that smell in Port Piscarilius?
Player
It is a bit ripe there.
Commander Fullore
Imagine that but ten times worse. That's what it was like before the Council had a new sewage system installed. The entire kingdom is now cleaner and safer because of them.
Commander Fullore
Not only that, but without the Council, you wouldn't even be stood here. It was under them that trade with your lands to the east was established.
Commander Fullore
Without those trade routes, you would have no easy way of getting here.
Commander Fullore
I could go on, but I have more urgent things to attend to.
Player
Like the escape of Councillor Hughes?
Commander Fullore
Well, since it's clearly no secret, yes. The former Councillor is a dangerous individual, so I want her back in a cell as soon as possible.
Player
You know, I might be able to help you with that. In case you didn't know, I was the one who helped catch her in the first place.
Commander Fullore
So, this is what Martin has put you up to! Well, no thank you. The last thing I need is one of his people getting in the way.
Player
I'm not one of his people! I barely know him. I'm just a willing adventurer who wants to help.
Player
Think about it. However this investigation goes, you'll be seen as biased towards the Council. I'm a neutral third party with no ties to the Councillor or the protesters. I'm in an ideal position to help out here.
Commander Fullore
Hmm... you do have the experience. And I can't deny, the fact that you have the support of the protesters could be useful.
Commander Fullore
This whole situation with Councillor Hughes has caused enough civil unrest. We certainly don't need it to get any worse.
Commander Fullore
Alright, you can help. But for the duration of this investigation, you're working for me. What I say goes, is that clear?
Player
Crystal clear. Where do we start?
Commander Fullore
Right now we don't have any leads on where Councillor Hughes might have gone. I'm heading over to her home to see if there's anything there that can help us. You should join me.
Let's get going.
Player
Let's get going.
A cutscene begins. The player and Commander Fullore approach Kingstown, and are stopped by Tomas Lawry and Captain Ginea.
Tomas Lawry
Commander Fullore! How wonderful to see you.
Commander Fullore
Tomas! What are you doing here?
Tomas Lawry
Why, I'm here about Sophia Hughes of course! As the person who discovered her corruption in the first place, I was an obvious choice to lead the investigation into her disappearance.
Player
But that wasn't you! I did all the work!
Tomas Lawry
Ah, and hello again, my financially challenged friend! Of course, the capture of Sophia Hughes wouldn't have been possible without your minor contributions.
Commander Fullore
The Kourend Royal Guard are conducting the investigation, Tomas. Your presence is not needed.
Tomas Lawry
Well, that's just the thing. Councillor Andrews was so impressed with my work, he put me in charge of this investigation.
Commander Fullore
That is not his call to make! I'm in charge of Council security. This investigation is mine to lead!
Tomas Lawry
He is head of the Council. If he wants to make that call, he can.
Commander Fullore
Regardless...
Tomas Lawry
Look, I can see you're very passionate, which is wonderful. Tell you what, as you're so eager, I'll allow you both to help me in my investigation.
Tomas Lawry
Do join me inside when you're ready.
Commander Fullore
Captain Ginea. I'm guessing Lord Shayzien sent you.
Captain Ginea
He did. He's keen to see this Hughes business sorted quickly.
Commander Fullore
He's not alone there, but he doesn't need to worry. We have things under control.
Captain Ginea
Forgive me Commander, but it doesn't seem like you do. Hughes escaped from right under your nose, and now Councillor Andrews is putting his faith in Lawry over you.
Captain Ginea
While this may be Council business, Lord Shayzien is responsible for dealing with both internal and external threats. He wants to be sure that Hughes won't be an issue.
Commander Fullore
You have my word. She'll be back in a cell before the day is out.
Captain Ginea
I hope you're right. There's already a lot of doubt in the Council these days. It would be rather embarrassing for them if the Shayzien Army had to step in.
Player
For someone who supports the Council so much, you don't seem very happy about Councillor Andrews' decision.
Commander Fullore
I can support the Council while not agreeing with every choice they make.
Player
I feel like you're not totally being honest with me.
Commander Fullore
Would that be so wrong? I hardly know you.
Commander Fullore
Here's some advice for you
focus on the investigation. Leave the politics to the experts.
Player
Fine. I guess we'd better get started.
Cutscene ends, and the player is now in front of Councillor Hughes' house.
Commander Fullore
Have a look around the house and see if you can find any hints on where Councillor Hughes might have gone. I'll ask around out here and see if anyone's seen anything suspicious.
Player
Sounds good.
Commander Fullore
Good luck. Don't let Lawry get in your way.
(End of dialogue)
I just need to do something first.
Player
I just need to do something first.
Commander Fullore
Okay, just let me know when you're ready to depart.
(End of dialogue)
Player
Let's get going.

Commander Fullore;Komentaja Fullore
We will.;Me teemme.
Player;Pelaaja

Commander Fullore;Komentaja Fullore

Commander Fullore;Komentaja Fullore
And on that note, I wanted to give you a little something to thank you for all that you've done. Not just for Kourend, but for me as well.;Ja tassa mielessa halusin antaa sinulle pienen kiitokseni kaikesta tekemastasi. Ei vain Kourendille, vaan myos minulle.
Commander Fullore;Komentaja Fullore
This is a bad situation we're in, but without you things would be a whole lot worse. Lord Arceuus also sent something over for you. He said you'd know what to do with it.;Tama on huono tilanne, jossa olemme, mutta ilman sinua asiat olisivat paljon huonompia. Lordi Arceuus lahetti myos sinulle jotain. Commander Fullore;Komentaja Fullore

(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)

If the player is on the Ancient Magicks spellbook;Jos pelaaja on Ancient Magicks -loitsukirjassa

Hello there.;Hei siella.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
I have word from Sanfew that you have been very helpful in assisting him with his preparations for the purification ritual. As promised I will now teach you the ancient arts of Herblore.;Sain Sanfewilta tiedon, etta olet ollut erittain hyodyllinen auttaessasi hanta hanen valmistautuessaan puhdistusrituaaliin. Kuten lupasin, opetan sinulle nyt Herbloren muinaiset taiteet.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
Herblore is the skill of working with herbs and other ingredients, to make useful potions and poison.;Herblore on taito tyoskennella yrttien ja muiden ainesosien kanssa, valmistaa hyodyllisia juomia ja myrkkya.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
First you will need a vial, which can be found or made with the crafting skill.;Ensin tarvitset injektiopullon, joka voidaan loytaa tai tehda askartelutaitojen avulla.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
Then you must gather the herbs needed to make the potion you want.;Sitten sinun on kerattava haluamasi juoman valmistukseen tarvittavat yrtit.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
You must fill your vial with water and add the ingredients you need. There are normally 2 ingredients to each type of potion.;Tayta injektiopullo vedella ja lisaa tarvitsemasi ainekset. Jokaisessa juomatyypissa on yleensa 2 ainesosaa.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
Bear in mind, you must first clean each herb before you can use it.;Muista, etta sinun on ensin puhdistettava jokainen yrtti ennen kuin voit kayttaa sita.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
You may also have to grind some ingredients before you can use them. You will need a pestle and mortar in order to do this.;Saatat myos joutua jauhamaan joitakin ainesosia ennen kuin voit kayttaa niita. Tarvitset survin ja huhmarin tehdaksesi taman.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
Herbs can be found on the ground, and are also dropped by some monsters when you kill them.;Yrtteja loytyy maasta, ja jotkut hirviot myos pudottavat niita, kun tapat ne.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
Let's try an example Attack potion;Kokeillaan esimerkkia Attack-juomaa
The first ingredient is Guam leaf; the next is Eye of Newt.;Ensimmainen ainesosa on Guamin lehti; seuraava on Eye of Newt.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
Mix these in your water-filled vial, and you will produce an Attack potion. Drink this potion to increase your Attack level.;Sekoita nama vedella taytettyyn pulloon, niin saat Attack-juoman. Juo tama juoma lisataksesi hyokkaystasosi.
Kaqemeex;Kaqemeex
Different potions also require different Herblore levels before you can make them.;Eri juomat vaativat myos erilaisia Herblore-tasoja, ennen kuin voit valmistaa niita.
Congratulations! Quest complete!;Onnittelut! Tehtava suoritettu!

Well, there is a long standing rule of chivalry amongst the Varrockian aristocracy, where each noble family is in possession of a unique crest, which signifies the honour and lineage of the family. More than this;No, varrockilaisen aristokratian keskuudessa on pitkaaikainen ritarisaanto, jossa jokaisella aatelistoperheella on hallussaan ainutlaatuinen harja, joka ilmaisee suvun kunniaa ja sukulinjaa. Enemman kuin tama
Dimintheis;Dimintheis
however, it also represents the lawful rights of each family to prove their ownership of their wealth and lands. If the family crest is lost, then the family's estate is handed over to the current monarch until the crest is;Se edustaa kuitenkin myos jokaisen perheen laillisia oikeuksia todistaa omistusoikeus omaisuuteensa ja maihinsa. Jos perheen vaakuna katoaa, perheen omaisuus luovutetaan nykyiselle hallitsijalle, kunnes vaakuna on
Dimintheis;Dimintheis
restored.;palautettu.
Dimintheis;Dimintheis
This dates back to the times when there was much in- fighting amongst the noble families and their clans, and was introduced as a way of reducing the bloodshed that was devestating the ranks of the ruling classes at that;Tama juontaa juurensa ajoista, jolloin aatelisten perheiden ja heidan klaaniensa valilla oli paljon taistelua, ja se otettiin kayttoon keinona vahentaa verenvuodatusta, joka tuhosi tuolloin hallitsevien luokkien riveja.

time. When you captured a rival family's clan, you also captured their lands and wealth.;aika. Kun vangisit kilpailevan perheen klaanin, valloitit myos heidan maansa ja omaisuutensa.

Hello. Who are you?;Hei. Kuka sina olet?
Gordon;Gordon
The name's Gordon. Good day to you.;Nimi on Gordon. Hyvaa paivaa sinulle.
Player;Pelaaja
It's a nice farm you've got here.;Teilla on kiva maatila taalla.
Gordon;Gordon
Thank you. We built it ourselves.;Kiitos. Rakensimme sen itse.
Player;Pelaaja
Really? So you haven't been here long?;Todella? Et siis ole ollut taalla kauan?
Gordon;Gordon
Nope. Not too long ago you couldn't safely travel around these parts. Too many lizardmen. But then some Hosidius explorers discovered how fertile this land was.;Ei. Ei liian kauan sitten et voinut turvallisesti matkustaa naiden osien ymparilla. Liikaa liskomiehia. Mutta sitten jotkut Hosidiuksen tutkimusmatkailijat huomasivat, kuinka hedelmallista tama maa oli.
Gordon;Gordon
Lord Hosidius made a deal with Lord Shayzien and the lizardmen were cleared out to make room for the Farming Guild.;Lordi Hosidius teki sopimuksen lordi Shayzienin kanssa ja liskomiehet raivattiin tekemaan tilaa Farming Guildille.
Gordon;Gordon
When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.;Kun kuulimme, paatimme tulla tanne ja perustaa oman maatilan.
Need a hand with anything?;Tarvitsetko katta johonkin?

(Continues in Quest complete section.);(Jatkuu Quest complete -osiossa.)
Wizard Mizgog;Velho Mizgog
Give them here and I'll check that they really are MY beads, before I give you your reward. You'll like it, it's an amulet of accuracy.;Anna ne tanne, niin tarkistan, etta ne todella ovat MINUN helmiani, ennen kuin annan sinulle palkintosi. Pidat siita, se on tarkkuuden amuletti.
You give four coloured beads to Wizard Mizgog.;Annat nelja varillista helmea Wizard Mizgogille.
Wizard Mizgog places the four beads on the table and casts a spell on them.;Velho Mizgog asettaa nelja helmea poydalle ja loitsua niita.
The wizard hands you an amulet.;Velho ojentaa sinulle amuletin.
Congratulations! Quest complete!;Onnittelut! Tehtava suoritettu!

Player;Pelaaja
I went back to the place where I first met Vanstrom. He was gone though.;Menin takaisin paikkaan, jossa tapasin Vanstromin ensimmaisen kerran. Han oli kuitenkin poissa.
Veliaf Hurtz;Veliaf Hurtz
I feared as much. Worry not though. The day will come when we get our revenge on him and the rest of his kind.;Pelkasin yhta paljon. ala kuitenkaan huoli. Tulee paiva, jolloin kostamme hanelle ja muille hanen kaltaisilleen.
Veliaf Hurtz;Veliaf Hurtz
Anyway, now that you're back, there was something I was hoping you'd help us with.;Joka tapauksessa, nyt kun olet palannut, toivoin sinun auttavan meita.
Start the In Aid of the Myreque quest?;Aloita In Aid of the Myreque -tehtava?
Yes.;Joo.
Player;Pelaaja
What do you need?;Mita tarvitset?
Veliaf Hurtz;Veliaf Hurtz
Now that our base of operations is no longer safe, we're going to need to relocate before the vyrewatch descend on us.;Nyt kun toimintamme ei ole enaa turvallinen, meidan on muutettava ennen kuin vyrewwatch laskeutuu paallemme.
Player;Pelaaja
Seems like a wise move. What part do I play?;Vaikuttaa viisaalta toimenpiteelta. Mita osaa naytan?
Veliaf Hurtz;Veliaf Hurtz
To the south of Mort'ton there's an old town known as Burgh de Rott. The place was abandoned but I hear some escapees from Meiyerditch have made their home there.;Mort'tonin etelapuolella on vanha kaupunki, joka tunnetaan nimella Burgh de Rott. Paikka oli hylatty, mutta kuulen, etta jotkut Meiyerditchista paenneet ovat loytaneet kotinsa sinne.
Player;Pelaaja
And you want me to scout the place out?;Ja haluatko minun tutkivan paikan?
Veliaf Hurtz;Veliaf Hurtz
Exactly. Head down to Burgh de Rott and see if you can find a suitable place for our new hideout. While you're there, do what you can to forge a good relationship with the townspeople.;Tarkalleen. Suuntaa alas Burgh de Rottiin ja katso, loydatko sopivan paikan uudelle piilopaikallemme. Kun olet siella, tee kaikkesi luodaksesi hyvat suhteet kaupunkilaisten kanssa.
Player;Pelaaja
I'll get it done.;Saan sen valmiiksi.
Veliaf Hurtz;Veliaf Hurtz
Be sure to take a weapon of silver with you. You'll find it of great use if vampyres attack. Good luck to you.;Muista ottaa hopeaase mukaasi. Loydat siita paljon hyotya, jos vampyyrit hyokkaavat. Onnea sinulle.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)

Trufitus;Trufitus
Greetings Bwana! I am Trufitus Shakaya of the Tai Bwo Wannai village.;Tervehdys Bwana! Olen Trufitus Shakaya Tai Bwo Wannain kylasta.
Trufitus;Trufitus
Welcome to our humble village.;Tervetuloa vaatimattomaan kylamme.
Select an Option;Valitse vaihtoehto
What does Bwana mean?;Mita tarkoittaa Bwana
Player;Pelaaja
What does Bwana mean?;Mita tarkoittaa Bwana
Trufitus;Trufitus
Gracious [sir/lady], it means friend. And friends come in peace. I assume that you come in peace?;Armollinen [herra/rouva], se tarkoittaa ystavaa. Ja ystavat tulevat rauhassa. Oletan, etta tulet rauhassa?
Select an Option;Valitse vaihtoehto
Yes, of course I do.;Kylla, tietysti.
Player;Pelaaja
Yes, of course I do.;Kylla, tietysti.
Trufitus;Trufitus
Well, that is good news, as I may have a proposition for you.;No, se on hyva uutinen, silla minulla saattaa olla sinulle ehdotus.
Select an Option;Valitse vaihtoehto
A proposition eh? Sounds interesting!;Ehdotus vai? Kuulostaa mielenkiintoiselta!
Player;Pelaaja
A proposition eh? Sounds interesting!;Ehdotus vai? Kuulostaa mielenkiintoiselta!
Trufitus;Trufitus
I hoped you would think so. My people are afraid to stay in the village.;Toivoin, etta luulet niin. Ihmiseni pelkaa jaada kylaan.
Trufitus;Trufitus
They have returned to the jungle and I need to commune with the gods;He ovat palanneet viidakkoon ja minun taytyy olla yhteydessa jumalien kanssa
Trufitus;Trufitus
to see what fate befalls us. You can help me by collecting some herbs that I need.;nahdakseen millainen kohtalo meille tulee. Voit auttaa minua keraamalla joitain tarvitsemiani yrtteja.
Select an Option;Valitse vaihtoehto
Me? How can I help?;Mina? Miten voin auttaa?
Player;Pelaaja
Me? How can I help?;Mina? Miten voin auttaa?
Trufitus;Trufitus
I need to make a special brew! A potion that helps me to commune with the gods. For this potion, I need very special herbs, that are only found in the deep jungle.;Minun taytyy tehda erityinen juoma! Juoma, joka auttaa minua olemaan yhteydessa jumalien kanssa. Tata juomaa varten tarvitsen erittain erikoisia yrtteja, joita loytyy vain syvasta viidakosta.
Trufitus;Trufitus
I can only guide you so far as the herbs are not easy to find. With some luck, you will find each herb in turn and bring to me. I will give you details of where to find the next herb.;Voin vain opastaa sinua, koska yrtteja ei ole helppo loytaa. Hyvalla tuurilla loydat jokaisen yrtin vuorotellen ja tuot minulle. Annan sinulle lisatietoja siita, mista loydat seuraavan yrtin.
Trufitus;Trufitus
In return for this great favour I will give you training in Herblore.;Vastineeksi tasta suuresta palveluksesta annan sinulle koulutuksen Herbloressa.
Select an Option;Valitse vaihtoehto
Hmmm, sounds difficult, I don't know if I am ready for the challenge.;Hmmm, kuulostaa vaikealta, en tieda olenko valmis haasteeseen.
Player;Pelaaja
Hmmm, sounds difficult, I don't know if I am ready for the challenge.;Hmmm, kuulostaa vaikealta, en tieda olenko valmis haasteeseen.
Trufitus;Trufitus
Very well then Bwana, maybe you will return to me invigorated and ready to take up the challenge one day?;No niin, Bwana, ehka palaat luokseni virkeana ja valmiina ottamaan haasteen vastaan jonain paivana?
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
It sounds like just the challenge for me.;Se kuulostaa vain haasteelta minulle.
Player;Pelaaja
It sounds like just the challenge for me. And it would make a nice break from killing things!;Se kuulostaa vain haasteelta minulle. Ja se olisi mukava tauko asioiden tappamisesta!
Trufitus;Trufitus
That is excellent Bwana! The first herb that you need to gather is called;Se on loistava Bwana! Ensimmainen yrtti, joka sinun on kerattava, on nimeltaan
Trufitus;Trufitus
Snake Weed.;Snake Weed.
Trufitus;Trufitus
It grows near the vines in an area to the south west where;Se kasvaa lahella viinikoynnoksia alueella lounaaseen, missa
Trufitus;Trufitus
the ground turns soft and the water kisses your feet.;maa muuttuu pehmeaksi ja vesi suutelee jalkojasi.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
I am very sorry, but I don't have time for that.;Olen erittain pahoillani, mutta minulla ei ole siihen aikaa.
Player;Pelaaja
I am very sorry, but I don't have any time for that.;Olen erittain pahoillani, mutta minulla ei ole siihen aikaa.
Trufitus;Trufitus
Very well then, may your journeys bring you much joy.;No niin, tuokoot matkasi sinulle paljon iloa.
Trufitus;Trufitus
Maybe you will pass this way again and you then take up my proposal?;Ehka ohitat taman tien uudelleen ja otat sitten ehdotukseeni?
Trufitus;Trufitus
But for now, fare thee well.;Mutta toistaiseksi voi hyvin.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
I am sorry, but I am very busy.;Olen pahoillani, mutta olen erittain kiireinen.

Tai Bwo Wannai? What does that mean?;Tai Bwo Wannai? Mita tuo tarkoittaa?
Player;Pelaaja
Tai Bwo Wannai? What does that mean?;Tai Bwo Wannai? Mita tuo tarkoittaa?
Trufitus;Trufitus
It means 'small clearing in the jungle' but it is now the name of our village.;Se tarkoittaa "pienta aukiota viidakossa", mutta se on nyt kylamme nimi.
Select an Option;Valitse vaihtoehto
It's a nice village, where is everyone?;Se on mukava kyla, missa kaikki ovat?
Player;Pelaaja

Trufitus;Trufitus

Trufitus;Trufitus
You may be able to help with this.;Voit ehka auttaa tassa.

High Priest Bighead;Ylipappi Bighead
No other tribes disappear like Dorgeshuun, but over ages, tribes merge. Now most goblins, they not know what tribe they come from.;Mikaan muu heimo ei katoa kuten Dorgeshuun, mutta aikojen kuluessa heimot sulautuvat. Nyt useimmat goblinit eivat tieda, mista heimosta he ovat kotoisin.
High Priest Bighead;Ylipappi Bighead
Sometimes, goblins who know what tribe they come from, they come here and make tribal enclaves. They colour armour different colours to show what tribe they in. But not all tribes here.;Joskus peikkoja, jotka tietavat mista heimosta he tulevat, he tulevat tanne ja muodostavat heimoalueita. He varjaavat panssarit eri vareilla osoittaakseen, mihin heimoon ne kuuluvat. Mutta eivat kaikki heimot taalla.

Player;Pelaaja
Well, don't get any funny ideas! You promised you'd never cook another human if I helped My Arm grow goutweed.;No, alkaa saako mitaan hauskoja ideoita! Lupasit, etta et koskaan kokkaa toista ihmista, jos autan My Armia kasvattamaan kihtiruohoa.
Burntmeat;Poltettu liha
An' dat promise I is keeping! Never another human shall Burntmeat cook. Human taste plenty good raw if you add enough goutweed.;Sen lupauksen, jonka pidan! Kukaan toinen ihminen ei kypsenna Burntmeatia. Ihmisen maku on hyva raakana, jos lisaa kihtiruhoa riittavasti.

Ah [player name], glad to see you made it. Welcome to Lletya, home to the Elven Resistance.;Ah [pelaajan nimi], mukava nahda, etta onnistuit. Tervetuloa Lletyaan, haltioiden vastarinnan kotiin.
Player;Pelaaja
Thank you. It wasn't particularly easy to get here, it took some work to convince Islwyn I could be trusted.;Kiitos. Tanne ei ollut erityisen helppoa paasta, taytyi tehda toita vakuuttaakseni Islwyn, etta minuun voi luottaa.
Arianwyn;Arianwyn
That's not surprising, he is not particularly fond of humans. But if you've earnt his trust, it proves to me that I was right to take a chance on you.;Se ei ole yllattavaa, han ei ole erityisen ihastunut ihmisiin. Mutta jos olet ansainnut hanen luottamuksensa, se osoittaa minulle, etta olin oikeassa ottaessani sinut riskiin.
Player;Pelaaja
I'm glad you did. I hate the thought that I might still be blindly working for King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth right now.;Olen iloinen, etta teit. Inhoan ajatusta, etta voisin edelleen tyoskennella sokeasti King Lathasin ja Lord Iorwerthin hyvaksi talla hetkella.
Arianwyn;Arianwyn
Well you're here now and you still have a chance to right your previous wrongs.;No, olet taalla nyt ja sinulla on viela mahdollisuus korjata aikaisemmat virheesi.
Player;Pelaaja
I hope so. There's a lot I still don't understand though. Why are King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth working together? Where does the plague fit in?;Toivon niin. Paljon on kuitenkin mita en vielakaan ymmarra. Miksi kuningas Lathas ja Lord Iorwerth tyoskentelevat yhdessa? Mihin rutto sopii?
Arianwyn;Arianwyn
I'm afraid that a lot is still unknown to us as well. However, I will explain what I can. Be aware that this is only a brief overview. You'll find some books around the village that explain more if you wish though.;Pelkaan, etta meillekin on viela paljon tuntematonta. Selitan kuitenkin, mita voin. Huomaa, etta tama on vain lyhyt katsaus. Loydat kylalta kirjoja, jotka selittavat enemman, jos haluat.
Okay, let's begin;Okei, aloitetaan
Player;Pelaaja
Okay, let's begin;Okei, aloitetaan
Arianwyn;Arianwyn
Many years ago, all elves lived in harmony within the crystal city of Prifddinas alongside our goddess, Seren. When the God Wars ended, Seren was lost to us. For the first time, we were alone. To lead us through those difficult times, Baxtorian Cadarn was named trhe first king of the elves. Under Baxtorian, our kingdom expanded into the east. We prospered for a time, but little did we know that an enemy walked among us. During that time, Lord Iorwerth turned away from Seren and pledged himself to Zamorak, the Dark Lord. A larger kingdom meant our forces were further spread. Lord Iorwerth took advantage of that. He claimed Prifddinas as his own. Baxtorian tried to take it back from him, but Prifddinas was built to survive the God Wars. There was no way to retake it. In a last attempt to keep the city safe, Baxtorian and the clan elders sung the song of inversion which reverted the entire city into a crystal seed.;Monta vuotta sitten kaikki tontut elivat sopusoinnussa Prifddinasin kristallikaupungissa jumalattaremme Serenin rinnalla. Kun God Wars paattyi, Seren oli menetetty meille. Ensimmaista kertaa olimme yksin. Johtaakseen meidat noiden vaikeiden aikojen lapi, Baxtorian Cadarn nimettiin ensimmaiseksi haltioiden kuninkaaksi. Baxtorianuksen aikana valtakuntamme laajeni itaan. Me menestyimme jonkin aikaa, mutta emme tienneet, etta vihollinen kaveli keskuudessamme. Tuona aikana lordi Iorwerth kaantyi pois Serenista ja lupasi itsensa Zamorakille, pimeyden lordille. Suurempi valtakunta tarkoitti, etta joukkomme levisivat entisestaan. Lordi Iorwerth kaytti sita hyvakseen. Han piti Prifddinasia omakseen. Baxtorian yritti ottaa sen takaisin hanelta, mutta Prifddinas rakennettiin selviytymaan jumalansodista. Ei ollut mahdollisuutta ottaa sita uudelleen. Viimeisena yrityksena pitaa kaupunki turvallisena, Baxtorian ja klaanin vanhimmat lauloivat inversion laulun, joka muutti koko kaupungin kristallin siemeneksi.

Han joutuu tietysti kasittelemaan ensin.

Player;Pelaaja

Osman;Osman

Player;Pelaaja

Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have [number] council members left to protect!;Hyva tyoseikkailija, olen teleporttanut heidat turvaan! Sinulla on vain [numero] neuvoston jasenta suojeltavana!
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)

5.1 Using the brulee supreme on Sir Amik Varze;5.1 Brulee supremen kaytto Sir Amik Varzessa
Aris;Aris
To protect this noble knight from the magic of the culinaromancer, you will have to give him a creme brulee.;Suojellaksesi tata jaloa ritaria kulinaaromistajan taikilta, sinun on annettava hanelle creme brulee.
Aris;Aris
Not just any creme brulee mind you, but a creme brulee supreme!;Ei vain mika tahansa creme brulee, vaan creme brulee supreme!
Player;Pelaaja
Well that doesn't sound too hard. What's so supreme about a creme brulee supreme?;No ei se kovin vaikealta kuulosta. Mika creme brulee supremessa on niin huippua?
Aris;Aris
Are you going to constantly ask me questions?;Aiotteko kysya minulta jatkuvasti kysymyksia?
Aris;Aris
I am a fortune-teller, not a cook, and again I would suggest you speak to the cook next door who will be much more helpful on such culinary matters.;Olen ennustaja, en kokki, ja taas ehdotan, etta puhut naapurin kokin kanssa, joka auttaa paljon paremmin tallaisissa kulinaarisissa asioissa.
Aris;Aris
Although I happen to know that one of the ingredients is the egg of the evil chicken.;Vaikka satun tietamaan, etta yksi ainesosista on pahan kanan muna.
Player;Pelaaja
The evil chicken? Great. He only ever seems to show up when I don't want him to.;Paha kana? Loistava. Han nayttaa aina ilmestyvan vain silloin, kun en halua hanen nakyvan.
Aris;Aris
I believe the wise old man in Draynor has studied the Evil Chicken.;Uskon, etta Draynorin viisas vanha mies on tutkinut pahaa kanaa.
Aris;Aris
I would suggest you speak to him to get you on the right track. And tell him Bubbykins says hi.;Suosittelen, etta puhut hanen kanssaan saadaksesi sinut oikealle tielle. Ja kerro hanelle, etta Bubbykins sanoo hei.
Player;Pelaaja
Er... Bubbykins?;oo... Bubbykins?
Aris;Aris
That is not important right now. Go! Protect Sir Amik from the magic that threatens his life, my spell will only hold so long!;Se ei ole nyt tarkeaa. Menna! Suojele Sir Amikia taikukselta, joka uhkaa hanen henkeaan, minun loitsuni kestaa vain niin kauan!
Player;Pelaaja
Just give me 5 minutes and I'll be back!;Anna minulle 5 minuuttia ja palaan!
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Player;Pelaaja
Could you give me that recipe again, please?;Voisitko antaa sen reseptin uudestaan, kiitos?
Aris;Aris
Certainly, forgetful hero.;Varmasti, unohtava sankari.
Aris;Aris

Player;Pelaaja
Can we talk about what happened in the dining room?;Voimmeko puhua siita, mita ruokasalissa tapahtui?
Cook;kokki
Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!;Vau! Olit uskomaton! Tapa, jolla voitit Culinaromancerin, sai sen nayttamaan niin helpolta!
Player;Pelaaja
So... I don't suppose you can remember exactly how I defeated him can you?;Joten... Luulen, etta et muista tarkalleen, kuinka voitin hanet.
Cook;kokki
Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?;Tietysti! Mita osaa et muista tehneeni?

Protecting Sir Amik Varze;Suojelemassa Sir Amik Varzea
Player;Pelaaja
That white knight... Sir Amik Varze... I can't quite remember how I saved him...;Tuo valkoinen ritari... Sir Amik Varze... En oikein muista kuinka pelastin hanet...
Player;Pelaaja
but it was something to do with creme brulee supreme...;mutta se oli jotain tekemista creme brulee supremen kanssa...
Cook;kokki
Ah yes! Why, I was so impressed with that recipe you created that I memorised it!;Ah kylla! Olin niin vaikuttunut luomastasi reseptista, etta jatin sen ulkoa!
Player;Pelaaja
Ah, you did, did you? I don't suppose you could refresh my memory about that?;Ah, teit, vai mita? Et taida virkistaa muistiani siita?
Cook;kokki
But of course! It was an unusual dish, an unusual dish indeed! First you blend together, in a pot, some milk and some cream. Then add cornflour to the mixture.;Mutta tietenkin! Se oli epatavallinen ruokalaji, todella epatavallinen ruokalaji! Sekoita ensin kattilassa maitoa ja kermaa. Lisaa sitten maissijauho seokseen.
Player;Pelaaja
Cornflour? How do I... er, how DID I make that then?;Maissijauho? Miten mina... oh, kuinka tein sen sitten?
Cook;kokki
Oh, you told me you used sweetcorn in a mill!;Voi, kerroit kayttavasi sokerimaissia myllyssa!
Player;Pelaaja
Really? Weird. Okay, what did I do then?;Todella? Outo. Okei, mita mina sitten tein?
Cook;kokki
Then you travelled to the Kharazi Jungle and searched the plants there until you found a vanilla stick, which was then added to the mixture.;Sitten matkustit Kharazin viidakkoon ja etsit siella olevia kasveja, kunnes loysit vaniljatangon, joka sitten lisattiin seokseen.
Cook;kokki
After that you told me that you sought out and killed the fearsome Evil Chicken, to get one of his eggs, which was then mixed with the other ingredients.;Sen jalkeen kerroit minulle, etta etsit ja tapoit pelottavan Evil Chickenin saadaksesi yhden hanen munistaan, joka sitten sekoitettiin muiden ainesosien kanssa.
Cook;kokki
Finally you made some cinnamon by grinding the branch of a Dramen Tree and sprinkled it on top of the creme brulee.;Lopuksi teit kanelia jauhamalla Dramen Treen oksaa ja ripottelet sita creme bruleen paalle.
Player;Pelaaja
Sounds easy enough so far. Er, I mean it was easy enough up to that point.;Kuulostaa riittavan helpolta toistaiseksi. Tarkoitan, etta se oli tarpeeksi helppoa siihen asti.
Cook;kokki
Yes, but then came the impressive part!;Kylla, mutta sitten tuli vaikuttava osa!
Cook;kokki
Apparently, a creme brulee supreme needs to be flambed at exactly the right temperature, and the only fire that is hot enough to do this is the breath of a dragon. Luckily, while killing black dragons near the Evil;Ilmeisesti creme brulee supreme on poltettava tasmalleen oikeassa lampotilassa, ja ainoa tarpeeksi kuuma tuli on lohikaarmeen henkays. Onneksi tappaessaan mustia lohikaarmeita lahella pahaa
Cook;kokki
Chicken's lair, you came across a method of forcing a dragon to your will so that it would complete the dish, which you then used to protect Sir Amik!;Kananpesa, tormasit menetelmaan pakottaa lohikaarme tahtosi, jotta se taydentaisi lautasen, jota kaytit sitten suojellaksesi Sir Amikia!
Player;Pelaaja
I definitely said that I had to kill some black dragons to do that?;Sanoin ehdottomasti, etta minun piti tappaa joitain mustia lohikaarmeita tehdakseni sen?
Cook;kokki
Oh yes. You were quite adamant about it. Specifically black dragons. Specifically near the Evil Chicken's lair.;Kylla. Olit aika paattavainen asian suhteen. Erityisesti mustia lohikaarmeita. Erityisesti lahella Evil Chickenin luota.
Player;Pelaaja
Oh yeah... I remember now...;Ai joo... muistan nyt...
Cook;kokki
Did you want a reminder on any other of your brave exploits?;Halusitko muistutuksen muista rohkeista teoistasi?

(Non-quest dialogue) Lamps.;(Ei-seikkailudialogi) Lamput.
Your quest.;Sinun tehtavasi.
Player;Pelaaja
Good day. I was hoping you could help me with something. I have a book which mentions the fractional distillation of coal tar. I don't know how to do that though.;Hyvaa paivaa. Toivoin, etta voisit auttaa minua jossain. Minulla on kirja, jossa mainitaan kivihiilitervan jakotislaus. En tosin tieda miten se tehdaan.
Chemist;Kemisti
Ah, you'll be wanting to use the still then. It's just outside.;Ah, sitten haluat kayttaa still-kuvia. Se on vain ulkona.
Player;Pelaaja
How do I use it?;Kuinka kaytan sita?
Chemist;Kemisti
It's quite simple really. You have to get the still heat up very high for it to work. However, if it gets too hot it will burn out and you will have to start over.;Se on todella yksinkertaista. Sinun taytyy saada viela lampoa erittain korkealle, jotta se toimii. Jos se kuitenkin kuumenee liian kuumaksi, se palaa ja sinun on aloitettava alusta.
Chemist;Kemisti
You must also watch the pressure, if it gets too high you will also have to start over. There are valves to control pressure and tar flow. These will also affect the heat of the still.;Painetta on myos seurattava, jos se nousee liian korkeaksi, on myos aloitettava alusta. Siella on venttiileita paineen ja tervan virtauksen saatamiseksi. Nama vaikuttavat myos sammutuslaitteen lammoseen.
Player;Pelaaja
Is that all?;Onko siina kaikki?
Chemist;Kemisti
You'll also need plenty of coal to keep the still hot.;Tarvitset myos runsaasti hiilta pitaaksesi kuumana.
Player;Pelaaja
I see, thanks for the information.;Naen, kiitos tiedosta.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)

Player;Pelaaja
Fascinating. What do you mean by 'revert to seed'?;Kiehtova. Mita tarkoitat "palata siemeneksi"?
Islwyn;Islwyn
All elven crystal starts as a seed. It can then be sung into various shapes through the power of the voice. Eventually, it reverts back to seed, ready for the next song. Keep an eye out for an elf named Ilfeen as you wander the forest. She can chant crystal seeds into new items for you.;Kaikki haltioiden kristalli alkaa siemenena. Se voidaan sitten laulaa eri muotoihin aanenvoiman avulla. Lopulta se palaa takaisin siemeneksi, valmiina seuraavaan kappaleeseen. Pida silmalla tonttua nimelta Ilfeen, kun kuljet metsassa. Han voi laulaa kristallin siemenia uusiksi esineiksi sinulle.

Vaikuttaa silta, etta puhuin liian aikaisin. Tassa talismanissa on enemman kuin nakee. Itse asiassa se voi hyvinkin olla palapelin viimeinen pala.

Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
As you are likely aware, when we cast spells, we do so using the power of runes.;Kuten todennakoisesti tiedatkin, kun loitsumme, teemme sen riimujen voimalla.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
These runes are crafted from a highly unique material, and then imbued with magical power from various runic altars. Different altars create different runes with different magical effects.;Nama riimut on valmistettu erittain ainutlaatuisesta materiaalista, ja ne on sitten imeytetty erilaisten riimualttareiden taikavoimalla. Eri alttarit luovat erilaisia riimuja erilaisilla maagisilla tehosteilla.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
The process of imbuing runes is called runecrafting. Legend has it that this was once a common art, but the secrets of how to do it were lost until just under two hundred years ago.;Riimujen imeytysprosessia kutsutaan runecraftingiksi. Legendan mukaan tama oli aikoinaan yleista taidetta, mutta sen tekemisen salaisuudet katosivat vasta vajaat kaksisataa vuotta sitten.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
The rediscovery of runecrafting had such a large impact on the world, that it marked the dawn of the Fifth Age. It also resulted in the birth of our order, and the construction of the first Wizards' Tower.;Runecraftingin uudelleen loytamisella oli niin suuri vaikutus maailmaan, etta se merkitsi viidennen aikakauden aamunkoittoa. Se johti myos jarjestyksemme syntymiseen ja ensimmaisen Wizards' Towerin rakentamiseen.
Player;Pelaaja
If it was the first tower, I'm guessing it doesn't exist anymore? What happened?;Jos se oli ensimmainen torni, sita ei kai ole enaa olemassa? Mita tapahtui?
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
It was burnt down by traitorous members of our own order. They followed the evil god of chaos, Zamorak, and they wished to claim our magical discoveries in his name.;Oman ritarikuntamme petolliset jasenet polttivat sen. He seurasivat pahaa kaaoksen jumalaa Zamorakia ja halusivat vaatia maagisia loytojamme hanen nimessaan.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
When the tower burnt down, much was lost, including an important incantation. A spell that could be used to teleport to a hidden essence mine.;Kun torni paloi, paljon menetettiin, mukaan lukien tarkea loitsu. Loitsu, jota voitaisiin kayttaa teleportaamaan katketylle olemuskaivokselle.
Player;Pelaaja
The essence mine you mentioned earlier, I assume?;Oletan, etta aiemmin mainitsemasi olemuskaivos?
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
Precisely. Rune essence is the material used to make runes, but it is incredibly rare. That essence mine was the only place it could be found that our order knew of.;Tarkalleen ottaen. Runeessence on materiaali, jota kaytetaan riimujen valmistukseen, mutta se on uskomattoman harvinaista. Tuo essence-kaivos oli ainoa paikka, jonka tilauksemme tiesi.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
Since the incantation was lost, we have struggled to maintain our stocks of rune essence.;Loitsun katoamisen jalkeen olemme kamppailleet sailyttaaksemme riimuesanssivarastojamme.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
There are seemingly those out there that still know where to find some, but while they have been willing to sell essence to us, they have refused to share knowledge on how to find it ourselves.;Nayttaa silta, etta siella on niita, jotka tietavat edelleen, mista loytaa niita, mutta vaikka he ovat olleet valmiita myymaan esanssia meille, he ovat kieltaytyneet jakamasta tietoa siita, kuinka loytaa se itse.
Player;Pelaaja

Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
I do! All magic leaves traces, and from what I can tell, this talisman was used heavily during the time of the first tower.;Tahdon! Kaikki taika jattaa jalkia, ja mita voin kertoa, tata talismaania kaytettiin paljon ensimmaisen tornin aikana.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor

Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
Yes, this is it! The lost incantation!;Kylla, tama on se! Kadonnut loitsu!
Player;Pelaaja
So you'll be able to access that essence mine now?;Joten paaset nyt kasiksi tuohon essence-miinaan?
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
That's right! Because of you, our order finally has a proper source of rune essence again! Thank you, friend.;Oikein! Teidan ansiosta tilauksemme saa vihdoin taas kunnollisen riimuesanssin lahteen! Kiitos ystava.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
If you ever want to access the essence mine yourself, just let me know. It's the least I can do.;Jos haluat joskus paasta kasiksi essence-kaivoksiin, kerro siita minulle. Se on vahinta mita voin tehda.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
I will also share the incantation with others, including Aubury. When I do, I'll let them know that you are to be given unlimited access to the mine.;Jaan loitsun myos muille, mukaan lukien Auburylle. Kun teen, ilmoitan heille, etta sinulle annetaan rajoittamaton paasy kaivokseen.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
Oh, and you can have this air talisman back as well. I have no further need of it, and I'm sure you will find it useful.;Voi, ja voit myos saada taman ilmatalismanin takaisin. En tarvitse sita enaa, ja olen varma, etta loydat siita hyodyllisen.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
In case you didn't know, the talisman can be used to craft air runes. Just take it to the Air Altar south of Falador along with some rune essence.;Jos et tiennyt, talismania voidaan kayttaa ilmariimujen luomiseen. Vie se vain Faladorin etelapuolella olevalle ilmaalttarille rune-esanssin kanssa.
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
Don't worry if you can't find the altar. The talisman can guide you there. You may find talismans for other altars as well while adventuring. They'll let you craft other types of rune.;ala huoli, jos et loyda alttaria. Talisman voi ohjata sinut sinne. Voit loytaa talismaaneja myos muille alttareille seikkailun aikana. Niiden avulla voit tehda muuntyyppisia riimuja.

Great! Thanks!;Loistava! Kiitos!
Archmage Sedridor;Arkkimaagi Sedridor
My pleasure!;Ilo on minun puolellani!
Congratulations! Quest complete!;Onnittelut! Tehtava suoritettu!

Right...;Oikein...

Now, so far, our efforts to contain it have been largely successful, for the most part.;Saatat olla tietoinen tai ei, mutta rutto on levinnyt Lansi-Ardougneen. Toistaiseksi ponnistelumme sen hillitsemiseksi ovat olleet suurelta osin onnistuneita.
Councillor Halgrive;Valtuutettu Halgrive
However, some sheep recently escaped from a farm near the city. When they were found, we noticed that they were strangely discoloured, so we asked the mourners to examine them.;Jotkut lampaat pakenivat kuitenkin hiljattain eraalta maatilalta lahella kaupunkia. Kun ne loydettiin, huomasimme niiden olevan oudosti varjaytyneita, joten pyysimme surejia tutkimaan ne.

Councillor Halgrive;Valtuutettu Halgrive

Councillor Halgrive;Valtuutettu Halgrive
As the councillor responsible for public health and safety here in East Ardougne, I am in charge of dealing with this problem.;Kansanterveydesta ja -turvallisuudesta vastaavana neuvoston jasenena taalla East Ardougnessa olen vastuussa taman ongelman kasittelemisesta.
Councillor Halgrive;Valtuutettu Halgrive
We need someone to herd these sheep into a safe enclosure, kill them quickly and cleanly and then dispose of the remains hygienically in a special incinerator.;Tarvitsemme jonkun paimentamaan nama lampaat turvalliseen aitaukseen, tappamaan ne nopeasti ja puhtaasti ja havittamaan jaannokset hygieenisesti erityiseen polttouuniin.
Councillor Halgrive;Valtuutettu Halgrive
Unfortunately, nobody wants to risk catching the plague, and I am unable to find someone willing to undertake this mission for me.;Valitettavasti kukaan ei halua ottaa riskia saada rutto, enka loyda ketaan, joka olisi valmis suorittamaan taman tehtavan puolestani.

Phileas Rimor;Phileas Rimor

Phileas Rimor;Phileas Rimor

Phileas Rimor;Phileas Rimor

Player;Pelaaja
So?;Niin?
Phileas Rimor;Phileas Rimor

Jos tutkimusmatka todella epaonnistui, miksi kuningas kirjoitti Quidamortemista vuosia myohemmin?

Istoria;Istoria
Welcome to the Library Historical Archive.;Tervetuloa kirjaston historialliseen arkistoon.
(Non-quest dialogue) What is this place?;(Ei-seikkailudialogi) Mika tama paikka on?

I have a question about King Shayzien VII.;Minulla on kysymys kuningas Shayzien VII:sta.
Player;Pelaaja
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.;Minulla on kysymys kuningas Shayzien VII:sta.
Istoria;Istoria
Well you've come to the right place. What would you like to know?;No, olet tullut oikeaan paikkaan. Mita haluaisit tietaa?
Player;Pelaaja
I'm searching for information on an expedition to Mount Quidamortem during his reign.;Etsin tietoa tutkimusmatkasta Quidamortem-vuorelle hanen hallituskautensa aikana.
Istoria;Istoria
Ah yes, I know of that expedition. King Shayzien VII was one of Kourend's most notable rulers. According to the history books, his reign was defined by violence.;Ah kylla, tiedan tuon tutkimusmatkan. Kuningas Shayzien VII oli yksi Kourendin merkittavimmista hallitsijoista. Historiankirjojen mukaan hanen hallituskautensa maaritteli vakivalta.
Istoria;Istoria

Player;Pelaaja

Historian Duffy;Historioitsija Duffy

His reign was so dark, it became known as the Age of Strife.;Dark Altar oli avain Xericin voimaan. Sen ansiosta han pystyi hallitsemaan Kourendia vastustamatta lahes sata vuotta. What are the Tears of Guthix?;Mita ovat Guthixin kyyneleet?
Juna;Juna
The Third Age of the world was a time of great conflict, of destruction never seen before or since, when all the gods save Guthix warred for control.;Kolmas maailmankausi oli suurten konfliktien, tuhon aikaa, jota ei ole koskaan nahty ennen tai sen jalkeen, jolloin kaikki jumalat Guthixia lukuun ottamatta taistelivat hallinnasta.
Juna;Juna
The colossal Wyrms, of whom today's dragons are a pale reflection, turned all the sky to fire, while on the ground armies of foot soldiers, goblins and trolls and humans, filled the valleys and plains with blood.;Valtavat Wyrmit, joista nykypaivan lohikaarmeet ovat kalpea heijastus, muuttivat koko taivaan tuleen, kun taas maassa jalkasotilaiden, peikkojen ja peikkojen ja ihmisten armeijat tayttivat laaksot ja tasangot verella.
Juna;Juna
In time the noise of the conflict woke Guthix from His deep slumber, and He rose and stood in the centre of the battlefield so that the splendour of His wrath filled the world, and He called for the conflict to cease!;Aikanaan konfliktin melu heratti Guthixin syvasta unestaan, ja Han nousi ja seisoi taistelukentan keskella niin, etta Hanen vihansa loisto taytti maailman ja Han kehotti konfliktia lopettamaan!
Juna;Juna
Silence fell, for the gods knew that none could challenge the power of the mighty Guthix -- for His power is that of nature itself, to which all other things are subject, in the end.;Hiljaisuus laskeutui, silla jumalat tiesivat, ettei kukaan voinut haastaa mahtavan Guthixin voimaa - silla Hanen voimansa on itse luonnon voima, jolle kaikki muut asiat ovat lopulta alisteita.
Juna;Juna
Guthix reclaimed that which had been stolen from Him, and went back underground to return to His sleep and continue to draw the world's power into Himself.;Guthix sai takaisin sen, mika oli varastettu Hanelta, ja palasi maan alle palatakseen uneen ja vetaakseen edelleen maailman voimaa itseensa.
Juna;Juna
But on His way into the depths of the earth He sat and rested in this cave; and, thinking of the battle-scarred desert that now stretched from one side of His world to the other, He wept.;Mutta matkalla maan syvyyksiin Han istui ja lepasi tassa luolassa; ja han itki, kun han ajatteli taistelun arpeuttamaa eramaata, joka nyt ulottui Hanen maailmansa puolelta toiselle.
Juna;Juna
And so great was His sorrow, and so great was His life- giving power, that the rocks themselves began to weep with Him.;Ja niin suuri oli Hanen surunsa ja niin suuri oli Hanen elamaa antava voimansa, etta itse kivet alkoivat itkea Hanen kanssaan.
Juna;Juna
Later, Guthix noticed that the rocks continued to weep, and that their tears were infused with a small part of His power.;Myohemmin Guthix huomasi, etta kivet itkivat edelleen ja etta niiden kyyneleet olivat taynna Hanen voimaaan.
Juna;Juna
So He set me, His servant, to guard the cave, and He entrusted to me the task of judging who was and was not worthy to access the tears.;Niinpa Han asetti minut, palvelijansa, vartioimaan luolaa, ja Han uskoi minun tehtavakseni arvioida, kuka oli ja kuka ei kelvollinen saamaan kyyneleita.

Juna;Juna

Of the more delicate races there is now no trace, and almost no memory.;Vain vahvimmat rodut selvisivat Godwarsista, ja silloinkin vain hylkaamalla korkean kulttuurinsa ja suuntaamalla yhteiskuntansa sotaan. Herkemmista roduista ei nyt ole jalkeakaan, eika juuri mitaan muistia.
Juna;Juna

Juna;Juna

Juna;Juna

Juna;Juna

En tieda, kuinka he paatyivat tanne ja selvisivat tahan aikaan, mutta olen kiitollinen heidan seurastaan.

Guardian of Armadyl;Armadylin vartija
They are ancient and powerful beings! They are very evil! It is said that they once dominated this plane of existence, Zamorak was supposedly of their blood. They are far fewer in number now.;He ovat ikivanhoja ja voimakkaita olentoja! He ovat erittain pahoja! Sanotaan, etta he hallitsivat kerran tata olemassaolon tasoa, Zamorak oli oletettavasti heidan verestaan. Heita on nyt paljon vahemman.
Guardian of Armadyl;Armadylin vartija
Some still have presence in this world in their liche forms. Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
Ah yes, the urgent matter with the Doors of Dinh. Very clever Councillor Unkar. You put the human to work. I need a sherry.;Ah kylla, kiireellinen asia Doors of Dinhin kanssa. Erittain fiksu valtuutettu Unkar. Panit ihmisen toihin. Tarvitsen sherryn.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
Jorra! Bring me a sherry.;Jorra! Tuo minulle sherry.
Jorra;Jorra
Yes Lady Lovakengj.;Kylla Lady Lovakengj.

Human, we have a job for you.;Ihminen, meilla on sinulle tyopaikka.
Player;Pelaaja
Great. What do you need?;Loistava. Mita tarvitset?
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
One of the finest smiths in Lovakengj, Undor, has been investigating issues with the Doors of Dinh. We've just received word that he has found the problem. However, he has requested we send assistance.;Yksi Undorin Lovakengjin hienoimmista sepaista on tutkinut Doors of Dinhin ongelmia. Saimme juuri viestin, etta han on loytanyt ongelman. Han on kuitenkin pyytanyt meita lahettamaan apua.
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
Could you go to him and see what help he needs? You'll find him right outside the Doors of Dinh, north of Arceuus.;Voisitko menna hanen luokseen katsomaan, mita apua han tarvitsee? Loydat hanet aivan Dinhin ovien ulkopuolelta, Arceuusin pohjoispuolelta.
Who are you?;Kuka sina olet?
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
I'm Councillor Unkar, one of the members of the Kourend Council. We are responsible for running the entire Kingdom of Great Kourend.;Olen valtuutettu Unkar, yksi Kourendin neuvoston jasenista. Olemme vastuussa koko Great Kourendin kuningaskunnan toiminnasta.
Player;Pelaaja
What brings you to Lovakengj then?;Mika tuo sinut sitten Lovakengjiin?
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
It's important for the Council to maintain a good relationship with the rulers of the five cities. Although it is the Council that rules, we can only do so with their support.;Neuvoston on tarkeaa sailyttaa hyvat suhteet viiden kaupungin hallitsijoiden kanssa. Vaikka neuvosto paattaa, voimme tehda sen vain heidan tuella.
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
I'm here to help Lady Lovakengj out and to make sure she has everything she needs to rule effectively.;Olen taalla auttaakseni Lady Lovakengjia ja varmistamaan, etta hanella on kaikki mita han tarvitsee hallitakseen tehokkaasti.

What are the Doors of Dinh?;Mitka ovat Dinhin ovet?
Player;Pelaaja
What are the Doors of Dinh?;Mitka ovat Dinhin ovet?
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
They are a great set of doors built by a legendary smith, Dinh, in the early days of Kourend. They were created to imprison a deadly beast known as the Wintertodt.;Ne ovat upea ovisarja, jonka legendaarinen seppa Dinh rakensi Kourendin alkuaikoina. Ne luotiin vangitsemaan tappava peto, joka tunnetaan nimella Wintertodt.
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
Unfortunately, although the Doors kept the beast contained for over a thousand years, they've recently started to fail. The master smith, Undor, was sent to investigate.;Valitettavasti, vaikka Doors pitivat pedon sisallaan yli tuhat vuotta, ne ovat viime aikoina alkaneet epaonnistua. Seppamestari Undor lahetettiin tutkimaan.

Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
The human seems a bit lost councillor. Could you help them please.;Ihminen nayttaa hieman eksykselta neuvonantajalta. Voisitteko auttaa heita kiitos.
Player;Pelaaja

Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
Oh. What did I ask?;Vai niin. Mita mina kysyin?
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
We asked them to go and see what help Undor needed at the Doors of Dinh.;Pyysimme heita menemaan katsomaan, mita apua Undor tarvitsi Doors of Dinhissa.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
That we did councillor. Quite right. And what was it that Undor needed?;Sen teimme valtuuston. Melko oikein. Ja mita Undor tarvitsi?
Player;Pelaaja
Undor had found some damage caused to the Doors of Dinh. He suspected someone had sabotaged them. He asked me to fetch him Dinh's Hammer so that he could fix the Doors.;Undor oli havainnut Doors of Dinhin vaurioita. Han epaili jonkun sabotoineen heita. Han pyysi minua hakemaan hanelle Dinh's Hammerin, jotta han voisi korjata ovet.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
And?;Ja?
Player;Pelaaja
I found the hammer and gave it to Undor. He should be fixing the Doors as we speak.;Loysin vasaran ja annoin sen Undorille. Hanen pitaisi korjata ovet, kun puhumme.
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
Well this is excellent news. With the Doors fixed, the Wintertodt poses a far smaller threat to Kourend. Well done.;No tama on loistava uutinen. Kun ovet on korjattu, Wintertodt muodostaa paljon pienemman uhan Kourendille. Hyvin tehty.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
Yes, yes, wonderful stuff. I think I'll have a sherry to celebrate.;Kylla, kylla, ihania juttuja. Luulen, etta saan sherryn juhlimaan.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
Jorra! Bring me a sherry.;Jorra! Tuo minulle sherry.
Jorra;Jorra
Yes Lady Lovakengj.;Kylla Lady Lovakengj.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
...;...
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
Councillor, why is the human still here?;Valtuutettu, miksi ihminen on edelleen taalla?
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
I think they want a reward, Lady Lovakengj.;Luulen, etta he haluavat palkinnon, Lady Lovakengj.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
A reward?;Palkinto?
Councillor Unkar;Valtuutettu Unkar
Yes, Lady Lovakengj.;Kylla, Lady Lovakengj.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
Oh.;Vai niin.
Lady Vulcana Lovakengj;Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
Well here you go, have this then.;No niin, ota tama sitten.
Congratulations! Quest complete!;Onnittelut! Tehtava suoritettu!

Player;Pelaaja
That's unusually kind for you. Not going soft, are you?;Se on epatavallisen ystavallista sinulle. Ei mene pehmeaksi, ethan?
Hazelmere;Hazelmere

Hazelmere;Hazelmere
My autumn is ending, and only winter remains. Soon, it will fall to individuals like you to protect the Anima Mundi.;Syksyni on paattymassa ja enaa on talvi. Pian sinun kaltaisten henkiloiden tehtavana on suojella Anima Mundia.
Player;Pelaaja
What are you on about?;Mita sina puuhailet?
Hazelmere;Hazelmere
The Anima Mundi granted me a glimpse into the future. I had one final choice to make, and I made it by saving you. We now walk a path that we cannot stray from, so listen closely...;Anima Mundi antoi minulle kurkistuksen tulevaisuuteen. Minulla oli yksi lopullinen valinta tehtavana, ja tein sen pelastamalla sinut. Kuljemme nyt polkua, jolta emme voi poiketa, joten kuuntele tarkkaan...
Hazelmere;Hazelmere
Skilled brothers, numbering eight, will assemble to fight the Mahjarrat deceiver, and they be will[sic] heading northwards to confront him.;Taitavat veljet, joita on kahdeksan, kokoontuvat taistelemaan Mahjarrat-petturia vastaan, ja he ovat menossa pohjoiseen kohtaamaan hanet.
Hazelmere;Hazelmere
The time after this is... clouded to me, but I see you clearly, dressed in the evil garb of night, lightly decorated with ochre like burnished gold, and the rust colours of autumn leaves.;Taman jalkeinen aika on... minulle hamaraa, mutta naen sinut selvasti yon pahan pukuun pukeutuneena, kevyesti koristeltu okralla kuin kiillotettu kulta ja syksyn lehtien ruosteen vareilla.
Hazelmere;Hazelmere

Hazelmere;Hazelmere

Hazelmere;Hazelmere
Things might have been different, but I have made my choice, and it is up to you to prove that I made the right one.;Asiat olisivat saattaneet olla toisin, mutta olen tehnyt valintani, ja sinun on todistettava, etta tein oikean.
Player;Pelaaja

Hazelmere;Hazelmere
Dreams often reveal truths masked by the light of day, but I know the truth of what I have seen in my bones. I have seen my end.;Unet paljastavat usein paivanvalon peittamia totuuksia, mutta tiedan totuuden siita, mita olen nahnyt luissani. Olen nahnyt loppuni.
Player;Pelaaja
But you can't die! You're a mighty wizard!;Mutta et voi kuolla! Olet mahtava velho!
Hazelmere;Hazelmere

Player;Pelaaja

Hazelmere;Hazelmere

Player;Pelaaja
But what about Glouphrie?;Mutta enta Glouphrie?
Hazelmere;Hazelmere

Mieluiten sen jalkeen, kun Arposandraan on loydetty parempi tapa.
Hazelmere;Hazelmere

How do I manage the kingdom?;Kuinka hallitsen valtakuntaa?
Advisor Ghrim;Neuvonantaja Ghrim
Your loyal subjects work hard to collect resources for you. Every day they bring what they have collected to the castle. The resources which they collect are coal from the rocks to the north, maple logs from the trees;Uskolliset alaisesi tekevat lujasti toita keratakseen resursseja puolestasi. Joka paiva he tuovat linnaan keraamansa. Heidan keraamansa luonnonvarat ovat kivihiilta pohjoisessa ja vaahteratukkeja puista
Advisor Ghrim;Neuvonantaja Ghrim
to the east, herbs from the garden just outside the castle, and tuna and swordfish fished at the port to the south. They are paid from the money in the coffers; each day, one-tenth of the money in the coffers is;itaan, yrtteja puutarhasta aivan linnan ulkopuolella, ja tonnikalaa ja miekkakalaa kalastettu satamassa etelassa. Ne maksetaan kassarahoista; joka paiva kymmenesosa kassan rahoista on
Advisor Ghrim;Neuvonantaja Ghrim
distributed to them. A maximum of 50k is paid to your subjects and the coffers can store up to 5 million gp. Another thing which affects the amounts of resources collected is your approval rating. The more your;jaettu heille. Kohteillesi maksetaan enintaan 50 000 ja kassaan voi tallentaa jopa 5 miljoonaa gp:ta. Toinen asia, joka vaikuttaa kerattyjen resurssien maaraan, on hyvaksyntaluokitus. Mita enemman sinun
Advisor Ghrim;Neuvonantaja Ghrim
subjects love you, the more they will be motivated to work hard. King Vargas would often go and help out his subjects in their daily tasks, when he was still able to do so, and they loved him dearly for it. Finally, you;aiheet rakastavat sinua, sita enemman he ovat motivoituneita tyoskentelemaan kovasti. Kuningas Vargas meni usein auttamaan alamaisiaan heidan paivittaisissa toissaan, kun han viela pystyi tekemaan niin, ja he rakastivat hanta suuresti siita syysta. Lopuksi sina
Advisor Ghrim;Neuvonantaja Ghrim
can choose how much of their efforts your subjects devote to each resource; of course, the harder they work at collecting one, the less time they have to spend collecting the others.;voivat valita, kuinka paljon ponnisteluistaan tutkittavasi omistavat kullekin resurssille; tietenkin, mita kovemmin he tyoskentelevat keratakseen yhden, sita vahemman heilla on aikaa kerata muita.
Advisor Ghrim;Neuvonantaja Ghrim

Setting your appearanceBefore you get started, you'll need to set the appearance of your character. Please use the open interface to set your appearance.;Ulkonakosi maarittaminen Ennen kuin aloitat, sinun on maaritettava hahmosi ulkonako. Kayta avointa kayttoliittymaa ulkoasun maarittamiseen.
Getting startedBefore you begin, have a read through the controls guide below. When you're ready to get started, tap on the Gielinor Guide. He is indicated by a flashing yellow arrow.;Aloittaminen Ennen kuin aloitat, lue alla oleva ohjausopas lapi. Kun olet valmis aloittamaan, napauta Gielinor-opasta. Hanta osoittaa vilkkuva keltainen nuoli.

Greetings! I see you are a new arrival to the world of Gielinor. My job is to welcome all new visitors. So welcome!;Terveisia! Naen, etta olet uusi tulokas Gielinorin maailmaan. Tehtavani on toivottaa kaikki uudet kavijat tervetulleiksi. Joten tervetuloa!

Survival Expert;Selviytymisen asiantuntija
The first skill we're going to look at is Fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.;Ensimmainen taito, jota tarkastelemme, on kalastus. Tassa lammikossa on katkarapuja. Yritetaan saada muutama.
The survival expert gives you a small fishing net.;Selviytymisasiantuntija antaa sinulle pienen kalaverkon.
You've been given an item To view the item you've been given, you'll need to open your inventory. To do so, tap on the flashing backpack icon to the right hand side of your screen.;Sinulle on annettu tuote Nahdaksesi sinulle annetun esineen, sinun on avattava varastosi. Voit tehda taman napauttamalla vilkkuvaa reppukuvaketta nayton oikealla puolella.
FishingThis is your inventory. You can view all of your items here, including the net you've just been given. Let's use it to catch some shrimp. To start fishing, just tap on the sparkling fishing spot, indicated by the flashing arrow.;KalastusTama on varastosi. Voit tarkastella kaikkia tuotteesi taalla, mukaan lukien verkko, jonka olet juuri antanut. Kaytetaan sita katkarapujen pyytamiseen. Survival Expert;Selviytymisen asiantuntija
Hello again. First up, we're going to do some fishing There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.;Hei taas. Ensinnakin, aiomme kalastaa. Tassa lammikossa on katkarapuja. Yritetaan saada muutama.

Han meni salaiseen kotiin, jonka han oli rakentanut Glarialille vesiputouksen alle ja sulki itsensa sisaan. Tahan paivaan mennessa kukaan ei ole paassyt sisaan.

Player;Pelaaja
What do you do for fun on this ship? You know, when you're not doing pirate stuff.;Mita teet huviksesi talla laivalla? Tiedatko, kun et tee merirosvojuttuja.
'Eagle-eye' Shultz;"Kotkansilma" Shultz
All sorts! Hide and seek, pin the patch on the pirate, walk the plank!;Kaikenlaisia! Piilota ja etsi, kiinnita paikka merirosvoon, kavele lankkua!
Player;Pelaaja
What a life! Wait a minute. 'Walk the plank'? Surely that's a bit dangerous?;Mika elama! Odota hetki. 'Kavella lankulla'? Se on varmasti vahan vaarallista?
'Eagle-eye' Shultz;"Kotkansilma" Shultz
Well of course, but where's the fun without a few deaths?;No tietysti, mutta missa on hauskaa ilman muutamaa kuolemaa?
Player;Pelaaja
I think I'll stick to Runelink.;Taidan pysya Runelinkissa.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)

Player;Pelaaja
What are you up to?;Mita olet tekemassa?
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
Rock, Paper, Scissors. Can't you tell?;Kivi paperi sakset. Etko osaa kertoa?
Player;Pelaaja
It was more of a rhetorical question.;Se oli enemmankin retorinen kysymys.
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
Rhetora-what?;Retori - mita?
Player;Pelaaja
Shouldn't you be working?;Eiko sinun pitaisi olla toissa?
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
We are. It's team building.;Me olemme. Se on tiimin rakentamista.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Player;Pelaaja
Why, hello there!;No mutta hei!
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
What do you want?;Mita haluat?
Player;Pelaaja
Clothing.;Vaatetus.
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
Nope. Need mine.;Ei. Tarvitsetko minun.
Player;Pelaaja
Ah, come on. You know you want to give me free stuff.;Ah, tule. Tiedat, etta haluat antaa minulle ilmaisia tavaroita.
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
Stop bothering me, can't you see I'm busy!;ala hairitse minua, etko nae, etta minulla on kiire!
Player;Pelaaja
Yes, VERY busy I'm sure.;Kylla, ERITTaIN kiireinen olen varma.
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
Okay, okay.;Selva.
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
The other day I was drying my clothes on a line down by the shore. A storm hit and some of my clothing went missing.;Toissapaivana kuivasin vaatteitani rantaviivalla. Myrsky iski ja osa vaatteistani katosi.
Player;Pelaaja
Likely story. Sure you weren't skinny dipping?;Todennakoinen tarina. Et varma, ettet ollut laiha dippauksessa?
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
Just go look and leave me be! Search around the tower and you may find them.;Mene vain katsomaan ja anna minun olla! Etsi ympari tornia ja saatat loytaa heidat.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Player;Pelaaja
You winning?;Voitatko sina?
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
It's a draw at the moment. First it was best of three, then it was best of five.;Talla hetkella on tasapeli. Ensin se oli paras kolmesta, sitten paras viidesta.
Player;Pelaaja
And now?;Ja nyt?
'Gummy';'kumimainen'
Best of a hundred and one.;Paras sadasta yhdesta.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)

Dialogue 3;Vuoropuhelu 3
Player;Pelaaja
Hello.;Hei.
Player;Pelaaja
You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.;Tiedatko, olen aina ihmetellyt, mita elama merirosvona oikeastaan sisaltaa.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.;No, talla hetkella siihen liittyy enimmakseen salamatkustajan satunnaisia kysymyksia.
Player;Pelaaja
I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!;En ole salamatkustaja! Minut kutsuttiin kyytiin! Kirjailija: Lokar! Kysy hanelta!
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.;Hei, mita tahansa [rakkaus/kaveri]. Varmista vain, etta kapteeni ei saa sinua kiinni, merirosvot eivat pida salamatkustajista paljon.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Dialogue 4;Dialogi 4
Player;Pelaaja
Hello.;Hei.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?;Ah, hyvaa paivaa sinulle [milady/sirrah]! Kasvosi ovat tuntemattomat, liitytko kenties joukkoomme Lunar Islen laivaan?
Player;Pelaaja
No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.;Ei, vaan Lokar tarjosi minulle hissia Rellekassa.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!;Todellako? Et nayta minusta fremennikilta!
Player;Pelaaja
Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.;No... Olen tavallaan, ja tavallaan en ole. Se on pitka tarina.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a- fremennik!;Anteeksi, kun minulla ei ole aikaa kuulla sita! Nahdaan nuorten fremennik-joka-ei-todellakaan-fremennikkien luona!
Player;Pelaaja
'Bye.;'Hei hei.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Dialogue 5;Vuoropuhelu 5
Player;Pelaaja
Hello.;Hei.
Player;Pelaaja
Brrrr! Its cold up here!;Brrrr! Taalla on kylma!
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!;Onko tama mielestasi kylmaa? Acheronin luona on niin kylma, etta kun puhut, naet sanat jaatyvan ilmaan edessasi!
Player;Pelaaja
REALLY?;TODELLA?
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!;No ei todellakaan. Liioittelin huumorin vuoksi. Se on kuitenkin erittain kylma!
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Dialogue 6;Dialogi 6
Player;Pelaaja
Hello.;Hei.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Hello to you too.;Hei sinullekin.
Player;Pelaaja
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!;Yar! Ollaan merirosvoja, yar! Avast, sina keripukki maata liukasteleva litsi!
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.;ala puhu noin, se on erittain arsyttavaa.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee

Player;Pelaaja
Oh. Okay. Sorry.;Vai niin. Okei. Anteeksi.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Dialogue 7;Dialogi 7
Player;Pelaaja
Hello.;Hei.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!;ARGH! SOITA HaLYTYS! VaLIAIKAA LAUSSA! VaLIAIKAA LAUSSA!
Player;Pelaaja

Player;Pelaaja

'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee

Player;Pelaaja

Dialogue 8;Dialogi 8
Player;Pelaaja
Hello.;Hei.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Hello.;Hei.
Player;Pelaaja
So... You're a pirate, huh?;Joten... Olet merirosvo, vai mita?
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.;Nain lukee palkkapaketissani kuun lopussa.
Player;Pelaaja
How's that working out for you?;Miten se toimii sinulle?
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.;Aika hyvin tahan mennessa. Kaikki grogit ja ryostot, jotka voimme ryostaa, seka taydellinen laaketiede, mukaan lukien hammaslaakarit.
Player;Pelaaja
You mean you have insurance?;Tarkoitatko, etta sinulla on vakuutus?
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.;Ei sellaisenaan. Jos joku meista sairastuu, sieppaamme laakarin emmeka paasta hanta menemaan ennen kuin olemme paremmin.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.;Yllatyt, mika kannustin asiantuntevaan terveydenhuoltoon se on.
Player;Pelaaja
I can imagine.;Voin kuvitella.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Dialogue 9;Dialogi 9
Player;Pelaaja
Hello.;Hei.
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee

Player;Pelaaja

'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!;Kylla, han on kaunotar! Lady Zay on ollut kotini monta kovaa kuukautta myrskyn ja auringon lapi, ja han saa meidat aina tanne, mihin olimme matkalla!
Player;Pelaaja
Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!;Kylla, han on varmasti yksi hienoimmista veneista, joita olen matkoillani nahnyt!
'Lecherous' Lee;"Ihme" Lee
That she is [lad/lass], that she is.;Etta han on [poika/tytto], etta han on.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)

Player;Pelaaja
You seem to like playing with danger, there.;Naytat tykkaavan leikkia vaaralla.
'No fingers';"Ei sormia"
They don't call me 'No-fingers' for nothing!;Minua ei turhaan kutsuta "ei-sormiksi"!
Player;Pelaaja
Well, correct me if I'm wrong, but you seem to have all your fingers.;Korjaa jos olen vaarassa, mutta sinulla nayttaa olevan kaikki sormesi.
'No fingers';"Ei sormia"
It may seem that way mate, but I think you'll find I don't have any.;Se saattaa nayttaa silta, kaveri, mutta luulen, etta huomaat, ettei minulla ole sellaista.
Player;Pelaaja
What?;Mita?
'No fingers';"Ei sormia"
These not be fingers. These 'ere be wooden fingers.;Nama eivat ole sormia. Nama ovat puisia sormia.
Player;Pelaaja
Wooden fingers?;Puiset sormet?
'No fingers';"Ei sormia"
Yep.;Jep.
Player;Pelaaja
That's not possible, how could you move them?;Se ei ole mahdollista, kuinka voit siirtaa niita?
'No fingers';"Ei sormia"
Magic wood.;Maaginen puu.
Player;Pelaaja
Yes, well I think I'd better be going now.;Kylla, mielestani minun on parempi menna nyt.
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
Player;Pelaaja
Hi.;Hei.
'No fingers';"Ei sormia"
Don't suppose you've seen any boots around here? Size nine, steel toed, brown leather...;Etko usko, etta olet nahnyt saappaita taalla? Koko yhdeksan, teraskarki, ruskea nahka...
Player;Pelaaja
Nope, not at all. I'd best be going. Have a nice day. Bye!;Ei, ei ollenkaan. Minun olisi parasta menna. Hauskaa paivan jatkoa. Hei hei!
(End of dialogue);(dialogin loppu)
